Authorisation procedures and formalities shall provide applicants with a guarantee that their application will be processed as quickly as possible and, in any event, within a reasonable period which is fixed and made public in advance. The period shall run only from the time when all documentation has been submitted. When justified by the complexity of the issue, the time period may be extended once, by the competent authority, for a limited time. The extension and its duration shall be duly motivated and shall be notified to the applicant before the original period has expired.

rew_raw:
Authorisation procedures and formalities must not be unreasonably burdensome or cause undue delays in service delivery; they should be easily accessible. Fees incurred by applicants as a result of their applications must be reasonable and proportionate to the actual cost of authorisation, and must not exceed said costs.  

The authorisation processes and formalities must provide applicants with assurance that their applications will be processed expeditily—no later than a predetermined, publicly stated timeframe. This period commes only after all required documentation has been submitted. In cases where complexity warrants, the authority may extend the timeline once, but any such extension must be brief. Both the extension and its duration must be duly justified and communicated to the applicant before the expiration of the original timeframe.\
